T001 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (BasisObjects.Rn n)) (X : Type u_1) [inst : MetricSpace X] (A : Set X) (a : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    (∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A = ⨅ U, ⨅ (_ : RealCover δ A U), realCost a U) ∧
      (∀ (ι : Type u_2) [Countable ι] (V : ι → Set X),
          ∃ e U,
            (∀ (k : ι), U (e k) = V k) ∧
              (∀ i ∉ range ⇑e, U i = ∅) ∧ ⋃ i, U i = ⋃ k, V k ∧ cost a U = cost a V ∧ realCost a U = realCost a V) ∧
        (∀ (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ),
            0 < δ₁ →
              δ₁ ≤ δ₂ → BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ₂) A ≤ BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ₁) A) ∧
          (∀ (δ : ℝ) (U : ℕ → Set X), 0 < δ → Cover δ A U → BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A ≤ cost a U) ∧
            (∀ (δ : ℝ) (b : ℝ≥0∞),
                0 < δ →
                  (∀ (U : ℕ → Set X), Cover δ A U → b ≤ cost a U) → b ≤ BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A) ∧
              H a A = ⨆ δ, ⨆ (_ : 0 < δ), BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A ∧
                (∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A ≤ H a A) ∧
                  (∀ (δ : ℝ),
                      0 < δ →
